name: overtime-request-role-workflow-ui
title: Complete overtime request workflow with correct roles
description: Allow Admin/Manager/HR to create employee-confirmed overtime requests, allow the target employee to confirm them, and harden staff self-service scoping for operational staff roles.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Role matrix: Admin/Manager/HR may create/review within restaurant scope; Accountant is read-only; operational staff roles are self-service only; only the target employee may confirm a manager-created request.
